headline: Profit and margins slide on pricing pressure

drivers.explanation: Higher lot costs, pricing pressure from affordability challenges and weak consumer sentiment, and about $24.8M of contract land deposit impairments.
Orders fell 7% with average order price down 5%; cancellation rate rose to 21% from 19%.
Settlements fell 7% to 5,268 units and average settlement price fell 2%.

summary_short: NVR's Q3 revenue was $2.40B (-8% y/y) and diluted EPS $89.45 (-20%), as homebuilding gross margin fell to 18.3% from 21.0%.
summary_long: Net income fell 27% to $248.6M. Margin was hit by higher lot costs, pricing pressure and $24.8M of land deposit impairments. New orders dropped 7% to 4,391 units, though backlog rose 10% in units to 10,121 and 4% in dollars to $4.59B. Mortgage banking pre-tax income rose 7% to $35.0M. NVR repurchased $237M of stock in the quarter. No guidance given.
